title: raw_vault pandas + Spark: per-ym sat_state_observation + R13 fix
objective: Partition sat_state_observation per-ym on both code paths (raw_vault.py pandas + raw_vault_spark.py Spark). ym derived via ym_from_epoch inside each build; address R13 by pre-filtering bronze state files on the sat_state_observation watermark before any read.
unblocks: T-12 (migrate_partition_ym can skip sat_state_observation when already partitioned)

files_changed.note: Added: defaultdict import; _group_state_files_by_ym helper (path-derived ym pre-filter); _build_sat_state_observation_per_ym (per-ym read, build, in-file ym via ym_from_epoch, write_partition + _DONE, per-ym watermark txn). Modified build_raw_vault: states_hub_input now filters by sat watermark (R13 fix); pandas branch calls _build_sat_state_observation_per_ym; include_states=False branch now reports vault_io.row_count instead of truncating the existing monolith/tree.

Added: _SAT_COLS_WITH_YM; ym column inside _build_group via utc-fixed pandas (never Spark date_format); ym field in _output_schema. build_sat_state_observation_spark rewritten: per-ym loop, watermark pre-filter (R13), resume via _partition_done, coalesce(1) + os.replace onto deterministic ym=YYYY-MM/part.parquet, _DONE sentinel, per-ym watermark txn. Removed shutil.rmtree(out_dir) at top (was wiping prior months).

Three-run smoke: bootstrap (2 partitions), resume no-op (mtime-equality + 7x faster), R13 (watermark=2022-06 against two-month fixture produces only ym=2026-11). Snapshots/restores ('vault',*) watermark rows. Uses real bronze head(5000) of date=2022-06-27 and date=2026-11-12.

integration_points.reads: bronze state parquet under <states_dir>/date=YYYY-MM-DD/hour=HH/*.parquet (filtered via extract_ym_from_path + sat watermark); pipeline_watermarks ('vault','sat_state_observation') via watermark.get
integration_points.writes: <out_dir>/sat_state_observation/ym=YYYY-MM/part.parquet via vault_io.write_partition (pandas) or Spark coalesce(1)+os.replace; <out_dir>/sat_state_observation/ym=YYYY-MM/_DONE sentinel; pipeline_watermarks row ('vault','sat_state_observation') upserted per ym via watermark.set, each in its own psycopg transaction

contract_deviations: Task text 'advance watermark.set in the SAME psycopg txn as the other vault watermarks (follow T-08 pattern -- all per-ym advances in one txn per ym)' is slightly reframed: the sat watermark cannot share the flightlist per-ym txn because the two live on different ym axes (flightlist month vs state-vector month). The implementation keeps T-08's pattern faithfully: per-ym, one psycopg transaction covers the write + the watermark upsert. The sat loop's per-ym txn is its own. Same semantic guarantee -- crash after write but before watermark leaves consistent state and a safe rerun.

Task text 'use ym derived via vault_io.ym_from_epoch(df["time"])' kept literally in the pandas path. In the Spark path the same semantics (utc-fixed pandas to_datetime + strftime) are inlined into _build_group so the UDF does not have to import vault_io on the executor; the two helpers produce byte-identical results. Verified on real bronze: path-derived ym (date=/hour=) matches per-row epoch ym on both 2022-06-27 and 2026-11-12.
spec_gaps_resolved: Task silent on 'what if the row's epoch ym disagrees with its path ym'. Implemented: assertion in _build_sat_state_observation_per_ym that set(epoch_ym) == {path_ym} per file group. On live bronze both agree. The assertion fails loudly rather than silently os.replace-ing a prior month's partition if upstream ever ships a row carrying a different month.

Task silent on 'include_states=False should not truncate existing sat_state_observation'. Previous code wrote an empty monolith via _write(pd.DataFrame(), ...) which would clobber a real 333M-row table. Replaced with vault_io.row_count(... root=out_dir); no writes.

Spark path: deterministic ym=YYYY-MM/part.parquet produced via coalesce(1) + os.replace of the single shard from a tmp dir (tmp name does NOT match 'ym=*' glob so readers never pick up a half-written shard).
risks: Late-arriving data: a bronze file dropped later into an already-watermark-advanced month will NOT be re-read (R13 filter uses month-granular watermark + per-ym _DONE). Known architectural limitation; matters for live REST in the current month. The rewind primitive (T-21, DONE) is the explicit path to re-process a month.

Spark path NOT executed in smoke -- pyspark not installed in the opensky conda env on this host. Syntax + import verified only. Logic parallels pandas path and shares _group_state_files_by_ym / _partition_done / _write_done. Full Spark run is a functional-tester task (T-26).
Per-run load_dt remains datetime.now(timezone.utc). Same pre-existing non-determinism T-11 flagged on T-08.
